case.title: Design: Duplicate opens an unsaved copy to name and create
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Note how many matrices the Matrices tab label shows (for example 7).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
case.custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open matrix A's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Duplicate.
  4. Click Cancel.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Duplicate and Delete.

Step 3:

  • A page opens in edit with the name field holding matrix A's name and " (copy)", Cancel and Create Matrix at the top right, as in picture 3.27.

Step 4:

  • The Matrices list shows again with 7 matrices: no copy was made.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the design differs from the PRD, waiting on the PO (question 7)
